blind.description: A stylized medieval-style banner stand consisting of a square carved stone plinth base with iron brackets, a vertical cylindrical wooden post with a spherical finial on top, an iron cross-joint collar holding a horizontal wooden arm with a metal end ring, and a red fabric banner suspended from the arm by two cloth loops. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or floating flakes. All components connect cleanly with no melted or fused artifacts. The model rests on its integrated square stone plinth whose underside sits flat on the ground. Materials include grey chiseled stone, brown wood, dark iron hardware, and red textile. There are no plain black or unpainted areas, and no flames or glow.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a horizontal wooden rod with two red bands/loops and a metal ring, intersecting a central sphere (the post finial) situated directly over the square stone pedestal beneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 7.5 to 8 ft tall (roughly 1.3 to 1.4 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure; the crossbar aligns just above the figure's head) and about 2.5 to 3 ft wide at the crossbar.

notes: footprint proportion 1.94x off the catalog (5.5 x 2.8 ft)
